svg.text: 106 plans read by 9 implementations, each answer compared with an expectation written from the spec.
An empty cell is silence — the implementation does not accept that plan — and is never drawn as a colour.
VIRTUAL TABLE ROWS AGAINST THE DECLARED SCHEMA
954 cells: 452 matched, 103 divergences, 11 unresolved, 6 at a type-system boundary, 301 not accepted, 81 without an expectation.
8 of these cases each pin a rule no other case pins; 3 rules are pinned by none.
